mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.audit_log ( department_id, actor_type, actor_account_id, attendance_day_id, action, target_type, target_id, before_data, after_data, reason ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, 'ACCOUNT', #{actorAccountId}, #{attendanceDayId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{beforeData} AS jsonb), CAST(#{afterData} AS jsonb), #{reason} )

INSERT INTO public.audit_log ( department_id, actor_type, attendance_day_id, action, target_type, target_id, after_data, idempotency_key ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, 'SYSTEM', #{attendanceDayId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{afterData} AS jsonb), #{idempotencyKey} ) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
